data.name: Dahyaa
data.gender_notes: Dahyaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'daheya' meaning 'gentle, kind'. This name evokes images of a gentle breeze or the soft glow of a candle. It is a name that speaks of kindness and freshness, making it an excellent choice for a child. The name Dahyaa carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Dahyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle nature of Allah, reminding us of His kindness and mercy.
data.etymology: Dahyaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dahyaa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
